findings.title: Reflected XSS via unescaped request.referer in postMessage
findings.body: In app/views/layouts/embed.html.erb line 11 the raw request.referer is interpolated into a single-quoted JavaScript string: parent.postMessage(..., '<%= request.referer %>'). Referer is attacker-controlled. A value containing ' , </script> or similar breaks out and executes arbitrary JS in the embed iframe origin. Fix by using escape_javascript / to_json for the origin and by passing only the origin (scheme://host:port), not the full URL.

findings.title: raw_html cook path stores unsanitized HTML leading to stored XSS
findings.body: Post#cook returns raw verbatim when cook_method is raw_html, skipping the entire rendering/sanitization pipeline. TopicEmbed.import sets cook_method to raw_html for RSS/readability content and app/views/embed/best.html.erb renders it with <%= raw post.cooked %>. Any <script>, on* handler, iframe or form in the feed or scraped article is stored and later served to all embed viewers. Fix by sanitizing on import or on cook.

findings.title: SSRF and unhandled fetch in import_remote
findings.body: TopicEmbed.import_remote calls open(url).read on a URL that ultimately derives from the embed_url query param via Jobs::RetrieveTopic -> TopicRetriever -> fetch_http. There is no timeout, size limit, error handling, or redirect restriction. TopicRetriever only checks the initial host equals embeddable_host, but open-uri follows redirects to any host and ignores ports, allowing port-scanning / internal network access and causing job exceptions / hangs when the remote site is down.

findings.title: PollFeed crashes on feed items without content
findings.body: In app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb line 35 the code does CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub) unconditionally. SimpleRSS items often have only link/title/description and nil content, so i.content is nil and .scrub raises NoMethodError, aborting the whole hourly poll and preventing any items from importing. Fix by falling back to description, handling nil, and rescuing fetch/parse errors.

findings.title: Invalid X-Frame-Options ALLOWALL breaks embedding
findings.body: EmbedController sets response.headers['X-Frame-Options'] = "ALLOWALL". ALLOWALL is not a defined directive. Browsers treat unknown values as DENY/SAMEORIGIN and will refuse to frame the content, defeating the embed feature. To allow framing the header must be removed, not set to ALLOWALL.

findings.title: Unescaped URL interpolated into imported HTML
findings.body: TopicEmbed.import builds "#{url}" with only a /^https?\:\/\// check. A URL like http://x/'>

findings.title: content_sha1 updated even if revision fails
findings.body: In TopicEmbed.import the update path calls revisor.revise! then unconditionally does embed.update_column(:content_sha1, content_sha1). If revise! returns false or the post is nil/deleted, the hash is still advanced, so the new content is lost and will never be retried because future imports compare equal. Fix by only updating the hash on successful revision and handling missing embed.post.

findings.title: Non-atomic throttle key can leak permanently
findings.body: TopicRetriever#retrieved_recently? does $redis.setnx(key,1) then $redis.expire(key,60) as two separate commands. If the process crashes between them the key never expires and that embed_url is throttled forever. It also creates one unbounded key per distinct URL. Fix by using a single atomic SETEX / SET NX EX.

findings.title: EmbedController spec contradicts implementation
findings.body: The spec expects EmbedController#best to call TopicRetriever.new(...).retrieve when no embed exists, but the implementation enqueues Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic,...) and renders loading. The test will fail and does not cover the actual async path, the 1.minute expiry, or visibility of the TopicView. Fix the spec to expect the job enqueue.
